scope: Representation and evidence-independence handling only; historical acceptance criteria and scoring locks are unchanged.

rerun_rule: Modify the frozen parser only to implement this source-class handling, commit the successor apparatus, regenerate fresh HRAiN snapshots on that successor commit, then rerun from scratch.
canonical_seal: VERIFY EVERY FROZEN FILE, BUT NEVER COUNT A MEMORY EXPORT AS AN INDEPENDENT WITNESS TO THE MEMORY IT COPIES.
